name: APEXREST
author: APEXREST
description: APEXREST in the Omarchy bar: live local previews, recent APEXlang projects with Git changes, sync state and the last deployment, and open review comments waiting for an agent. Start, open or stop a local preview, or open a terminal, Claude Code or Codex in a project. Never deploys or opens a database session.

barWidget.description: The APEXREST mark with a live-preview and review-comment count; the panel lists previews and projects with preview, agent and terminal shortcuts.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: Each refresh runs the local, read-only APEXREST CLI status commands; no database or network call. Set 0 in shell.json to refresh only when the panel opens.

schema.label: Desktop notifications
schema.description: Notify about new review comments in a local preview and about finished or failed deployments.

schema.label: Projects shown
schema.description: Pinned projects first, then the most recently used APEXREST projects.

schema.label: Show scratch projects
schema.description: Also list recent projects under /tmp, such as agent scratchpads.
